block-guide:
YOAST-SEO/BREADCRUMBS (Yoast Breadcrumbs) The Yoast SEO breadcrumb trail of the page it is shown on (Home » … » current page). The block exists only while Yoast SEO is active. The server draws it on every request; it stores nothing. Place it in a page, or once in a template or shared header so every page gets its trail. MARKUP (comment only, no HTML) With a class of your own: It draws
Home » Page title
. The block has no colour, spacing or alignment settings; to space it, put it in a group. WHERE THE WORDS COME FROM The "Home" label, the separator and the archive / search prefixes are Yoast's breadcrumb settings, not block attributes. PITFALLS - core/breadcrumbs is WordPress's own breadcrumb block; one trail per page is enough. - Yoast's BreadcrumbList in the structured data is published with or without this block. CHECK Open a page that has parents: the trail shows them, and the last item is the page, not a link.
